en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Phantom Blade Zero launches with a reported Metacritic score of 88

entries.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 arrives November 6 with three maps and a DMZ update
entries.summary: PlayStation Blog says Season 1 launches November 6 with three multiplayer maps, new modes, and new DMZ content.
entries.verification: The first-party PlayStation Blog post directly states the date and major update details.
entries.timeNote: The official post was published at 01:15 Beijing time on October 29; the season launches November 6.

entries.headline: めっちゃカメレオン adds a free major update with 24-player team battles and two maps
entries.summary: Three Japanese outlets report that a free update released after Indie World, adding team battles for up to 24 players and two maps.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON, 4Gamer, and Denfaminico independently corroborate the update.
entries.timeNote: The earliest cited report was published at 22:34 Beijing time on October 28; the update is already live.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: No Man's Sky launches the Forsaken update with new Corvette cockpits and courier missions
entries.summary: Xbox Wire says the Halloween-themed Forsaken update is live with new Corvette cockpits, a minimal HUD, a radial weapon selector, and courier missions.
entries.verification: The official Xbox Wire post directly lists the update status and features.
entries.timeNote: The official post was published at 22:00 Beijing time on October 28; the update launched the same day.

entries.headline: PlayStation 5 Prism Collection opens preorders November 10 and launches February 4
entries.summary: PlayStation unveiled translucent DualSense controllers and PS5 covers in Flare Orange, Emerald Green, and Graphite Gray. Preorders open at 10 a.m. local time November 10, with launch set for February 4, 2027; availability varies by region.
entries.verification: The global PlayStation Blog announcement directly states the colors and timing.
entries.timeNote: The official post was published at 23:00 Beijing time on October 28; preorder timing follows local market rules.

entries.headline: Football Manager 27 developers discuss its real-world football impact as the PC version launches
entries.summary: The Official Xbox Podcast interviews Sports Interactive about the series' influence on clubs and football professionals. The Xbox PC version launches October 29, followed by console on November 10, both on Game Pass.
entries.verification: The official Xbox Wire podcast page directly provides the interview and release details.
entries.timeNote: The official episode was published at 01:05 Beijing time on October 29; release dates come from the same source.

entries.headline: Phantom Blade Zero details boss weapons that transform across combat and exploration
entries.summary: A PlayStation Blog developer feature explains how boss weapons change form and connect combat with environmental exploration.
entries.verification: The PlayStation Blog feature carries a first-party developer explanation.
entries.timeNote: The official developer post was published at 10:00 Beijing time on October 29.

entries.headline: Rayman Legends Retold adds a free Astro Bot costume on December 3
entries.summary: PlayStation Blog says Rayman Legends Retold launches December 3, with a free Astro Bot-themed costume available on PS5 and PS5 Pro.
entries.verification: The official PlayStation Blog post directly states the date, platforms, and free costume.
entries.timeNote: The official post was published at 21:01 Beijing time on October 28; the game and costume are due December 3.

entries.headline: Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation 3 announced for PS5 and Steam as a free-to-play title
entries.summary: AUTOMATON and Famitsu report that the new installment is coming to PS5 and Steam, with free-to-play access, SP skills, and mobile suits from additional Gundam universes.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and Famitsu independently corroborate the announcement.
entries.timeNote: The earliest cited report was published at 19:40 Beijing time on October 28; no release date was announced.

entries.headline: R.E.P.O. is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027
entries.summary: AUTOMATON and Denfaminico report that the cooperative horror game is scheduled for Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and Denfaminico independently corroborate the platform announcement.
entries.timeNote: The earliest cited report was published at 22:24 Beijing time on October 28; only a 2027 window is confirmed.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: BAKUDO targets 2027 on Switch 2 and Steam with school sci-fi ball-sport boss battles
entries.summary: 4Gamer and Famitsu describe BAKUDO as an action game built around school science fiction and ball-sport boss fights, due on Nintendo Switch 2 and Steam in 2027.
entries.verification: 4Gamer and Famitsu independently corroborate the announcement.
entries.timeNote: The earliest cited report was published at 10:05 Beijing time on October 29; only a 2027 window is confirmed.

entries.headline: Phantom Blade Zero launches at 10 a.m. Beijing time with a reported Metacritic score of 88
entries.summary: Denfaminico reports that Phantom Blade Zero launches October 29 at 10 a.m. Beijing time on PS5, Steam, and Epic. Its Metacritic score was 88 at the time of reporting, and the game features more than 30 main weapons and 20 special weapons.
entries.verification: Denfaminico provides the launch timing, platforms, and a time-bounded Metacritic snapshot; the score is not treated as static.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 23:00 Beijing time on October 28; the game launches at 10:00 on October 29. The aggregate score is a reporting-time snapshot.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: Everything receives a major Steam update six years after launch with a rebuilt engine and microphone feature
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Everything has received a major Steam update rebuilding the engine and adding microphone-based interaction.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON reports and shows the Steam update details.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 15:12 Beijing time on October 28; the update is already live on Steam.

entries.headline: October's Indie World sets release windows for Witchbrook and several other indie games
entries.summary: IGN's Indie World roundup says Witchbrook launches January 28, 2027, Sword of the Sea reaches Switch 2 on October 29, and also covers City of None, Tenjutsu, and Threads of Time.
entries.verification: IGN provides a title-by-title roundup of the Nintendo Indie World announcements; it is not used as a substitute for missing primary calendar evidence.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 22:22 Beijing time on October 28; dates and windows are attributed title by title.

entries.headline: Cronos: The New Dawn story DLC Lazarus launches December 3
entries.summary: Gematsu relays the developer announcement that Cronos: Lazarus arrives December 3 with faster, more aggressive combat and a new protagonist.
entries.verification: Gematsu clearly attributes the announcement to the developer and includes the Steam overview.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 23:00 Beijing time on October 28; the DLC launches December 3.

entries.headline: 亰都ザナドゥ -桜花幻舞- releases a five-to-six-hour demo with save transfer
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that the demo is available on PC, PS5, and Nintendo Switch, offering roughly five to six hours of play with save data transferable to the full game.
entries.verification: 4Gamer lists the platforms, estimated demo length, and save-transfer support.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 09:00 Beijing time on October 29; the demo is already available.

entries.headline: Analyst estimates place Phantom Blade Zero digital preorders at about 850,000, with China above 60%
entries.summary: AUTOMATON relays an Alinea Analytics estimate of roughly 850,000 digital preorders, more than 60% from China. These are third-party estimates, not publisher-reported sales.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON explicitly attributes the figures to Alinea Analytics; only the conservative 850,000 and above-60% figures are used.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 20:05 Beijing time on October 28; the figures are a point-in-time third-party estimate.

entries.headline: Caladrius 2: Dark Element's Steam page disappears for an unknown reason
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that the Steam page for the game, previously scheduled for December 10 on PC, Nintendo Switch, and PS5, disappeared on October 28. No reason has been announced.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON reports the page status; the unknown cause is not framed as a delisting or cancellation.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 13:03 Beijing time on October 28; the page status and cause may change.

entries.headline: Alien: Isolation 2 targets 2027 with a physical edition, photo mode, and real-microphone feature
entries.summary: IGN relays a developer Q&A confirming a 2027 window, physical release, photo mode, real-microphone gameplay, outdoor sections, and a story set months after the first game.
entries.verification: IGN clearly attributes the details to the developer Q&A.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 02:47 Beijing time on October 29; only a 2027 release window is confirmed.
